dataModel.title: Incident Cards Near Gate
dataModel.goal:
User asked: "did anything unusual happen near the gate yesterday?"

Matching incident records (from local search over a CCTV events log):
[
  {
    "id": "evt_001",
    "camera": "gate",
    "time": "2026-04-23T12:14:03",
    "motion_zone": "entrance",
    "summary": "Two armed soldiers stand guard at a closed gate, with an airplane visible behind a fence and a building on the right.",
    "severity": "medium"
  },
  {
    "id": "evt_006",
    "camera": "gate",
    "time": "2026-04-23T12:16:32",
    "motion_zone": "exit",
    "summary": "A person in dark clothing stands on a sidewalk in front of a building with arched doorways, viewed through an archway.",
    "severity": "low"
  }
]

Compose an interface showing these as selectable incident cards (thumbnail-style: camera, time, a one-line summary, a StatTile for severity). Each card's tappable choice label MUST include the literal event id (e.g. "evt_003") somewhere in its text, verbatim, so it can be identified later. Do not fabricate any incident not listed above.
